title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Pod Fill x2 Cherry Strawberry 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Doozy’s Seriously Pod Fill x2 Cherry Strawberry blends the deep, juicy flavour of ripe cherries with the bright, sun-ripened sweetness of strawberries. The cherry provides a rich, slightly tangy note, while the strawberry adds a smooth, summery balance with a natural sweetness that lingers on the exhale. This vibrant fruit pairing delivers a well-rounded and satisfying vape. With a 50% VG / 50% PG formulation and double-concentrated flavour, this e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, making it ideal for low-powered vape kits, pod systems, starter devices, and high-resistance coils. The balanced blend ensures a consistent flavour with a tactile yet smooth throat hit and discreet vapour production. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing for customisable nicotine strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Doozy is a UK-based e-liquid brand known for its dynamic flavour profiles and high-quality formulations. The Seriously Pod Fill x2 range is crafted specifically for MTL vapers, delivering rich, concentrated flavours in a 50/50 mix designed for pod systems and starter devices.
